Report Description
A TRACTOR TRAILER STRUCK A MEDIAN GUARD RAIL, WHICH PUNCTURED BOTH SADDLE TANKS AND RELEASE APPROXIMATELY 100 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL ONTO THE SOIL MEDIAN AND ALSO IMPACTED A NEARBY STORM DRAIN THAT LEAD TO A CULVERT UNDERNEATH THE HIGHWAY. THE LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENT AND MCDOWELL COUNTY EM INITIALLY CONTAINED THE RELEASE WITH ABSORBENTS. HST CONTACTED ERTS ON DECEMBER 14, 2011 AT APPROXIMATELY 1845 EST TO MANAGE THE RELEASE. ERTS DISPATCHED AN ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR TO THE SITE ON DECEMBER 15, 2011 TO PERFORM CLEANUP OPERATIONS. THE ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR APPLIED GRANULAR ABSORBENTS TO THE IMPACTED CULVERT TO COLLECT THE CONTAMINATED WATERS. THE ABSORBENTS WILL BE LEFT OVER NIGHT TO COLLECT ANY POTENTIAL RESIDUAL. THE IMPACTED SOIL WILL BE EXCAVATED AND ALL WASTE WILL BE CONTAINERIZED FOR DISPOSAL.

*WEB REPORT* ON MARCH 31, 2011 I WOKE UP IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT TO HAVE THE HOME I WAS RENTING FILLED WITH SEWAGE WATER. I HAD BEEN REPORTING TO THE LANDLORD THE TOILETS WERE NOT WORKING PROPERLY, AND SEWAGE LEAKING OUT BACK ON THE PORCH NEXT TO THE WATER SYSTEM. ONE TOILET WAS SHUT DOWN FOR THREE MONTHS WITHOUT HIM REPAIRING. I OFFERED TO HAVE A LICENSE PROFESSIONAL TO COME AND FIX IT AND I WOULD DEDUCT IT FROM THE RENT. MR. PIEDRA STATED, "NO HE WOULD GET TO IT SOMETIME". WELL THAT 'SOME TIME' WAS TO LATE. AFTER REPORTING THE FLOOD IMMEDIATELY TO MR. PIEDRA, HE REFUSED MULTIPLE TIMES TO HELP MY FAMILY. I WAS LEFT WITH MYSELF, DAUGHTER AND THREE TODDLERS TO WADE THROUGH SEWAGE WATER. HE REFUSED TO REPORT THIS TO HAZMAT, FEMA, HIS HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE. HE TOLD ME, "IT IS YOUR PROBLEM". I HAVE LOST ABOUT 75% OF WHAT MY FAMILY HAD. I AM SLEEPING FIVE ON ONE KING SIZE WET MATTRESS ON THE FLOOR. FORCED TO MOVE MY FAMILY OUT IMMEDIATELY, I AM COMPLETELY OUT AS OF TODAYS DATE 4-19-11. MULTIPLE SHERIFFS REPORTS HAD TO BE MADE. NOW HE PLANS ON MOVING ANOTHER FAMILY IN THE HOME TO RENT IT WITH OUT ANY CLEAN UP. MY FAMILY ALL CAME DOWN WITH 'COLDS' AND FACE BREAKOUTS DUE TO THIS CONTAMINATION. NOW THIS NEW FAMILY WILL HAVE NO IDEA THIS HOME WAS FILLED WITH 'POOP-SEWAGE', BLACK MOLD ON THE WALLS AND CLOSET IN THE BEDROOM. THEY WILL HAVE NO IDEA THEY ARE MOVING THEIR THINGS INTO THIS CONTAMINATION.

Incident Type: FIXED
Material: F006 SLUDGE
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: CONNECTIVITY SOLUTIONS
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 10 gallons
A PIPE THAT LEADS TO THE INDUSTRIAL WASTEWATER TREATMENT CLARIFIER TO THE SLUDGE THICKENER BROKE WHILE FLUSHING OUT THE LINE. THE PIPE DIAMETER IS 2.5 INCHES AND THE PIPE LENGTH IS APPROXIMATELY 40 FEET. THERE WAS APPROXIMATELY 10 GALLONS OF WATER SATURATED WASTEWATER F006 SLUDGE IN THE PIPE WHEN IT RUPTURED. WHEN THE PIPING BROKE, WATER CAME UP OUT OF THE PAVEMENT AREA AROUND THE CLARIFIER AND 25 GALLONS OF WATER AND MUD WENT DOWN A STORMDRAIN APPROXIMATELY 40 FEET AWAY FROM THE CLARIFIER. THE PIPING VALVES WERE IMMEDIATELY CLOSED ON BOTH ENDS TO PREVENT FURTHER SPILLAGE. THE NE DEQ WAS NOTIFIED AS WELL AS THE CITY OF OMAHA POTW. IT IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME EXACTLY HOW MUCH F006 SLUDGE HAS IMPACTED THE SOIL BETWEEN THE CLARIFIER AND SLUDGE THICKENING TANKS, HOWEVER 10 GALLONS OF WATER AND SLUDGE WAS IN THE PIPING AT THE TIME OF RUPTURE. ONCE THE LOCATION OF THE PIPE RUPTURE HAS BEEN DETERMINED, THE AREA WILL BE EXCAVATED AND THE MATERIAL REMOVED AS A HAZARDOUS WASTE.

THE PAINT CREW WAS APPARENTLY WORKING ON A BOAT AND MAY HAVE DUMPED SOME OF THE PAINT THINNER INTO THE WATER. THEN THEY TRIED TO GET RID OF IT WITH A WATER HOSE. CALLER WAS ALSO TOLD THAT ONCE THE WATCHMAN APPROACHED THE INDIVIDUALS THEY IMMEDIATELY JUMPED INTO THEIR PICKUP TRUCK AND DROVE OFF.

properties.summary: Incident Type: PIPELINE - NRC Report ID: 1190605 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party: WILLIAMS
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1190605
Incident Time: 2017-09-17 12:30:00
Nearest City: Grover, NC
Location: PIPELINE FACILITY
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: SMOKE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: WILLIAMS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.170278, -81.410556 (Explicit)
Report Description
*****NRC REPORT # 1190605 IS AN UPDATE TO NRC REPORT # 1190605. THE UPDATE CLARIFIES THAT THERE WAS A RELEASE OF SMOKE CONFIRMED. THE INJURIES WERE INCURRED DURING MUSTER, NOT BECAUSE OF A RELEASE.***** INITIAL: AN ACCIDENTAL IGNITION OCCURRED AS CONTRACTOR WELDERS WERE INSTALLING A NEW SIDE GATE VALVE AT STATION 145. UPON COMPLETING THE REPAIR, THE WELDING PROCESS CONTINUED. UPON STRIKING THE FIRST ARC TO COMPLETE THE WELD, THE IGNITION OCCURRED. THERE WAS A LARGE PRESSURE RELEASE FROM AN 8" PORT AT THE LOCATION OF ONE OF THE INFLATABLE AIR BLADDERS AND THERE WAS NO FLASH FIRE ONSITE, RATHER THE FIRE APPEARS TO HAVE BEEN CONTAINED WITHIN THE PIPING AND EXTINGUISHED WITH THE PRESSURE RELEASE. ALL ONSITE PERSONNEL IMMEDIATELY MUSTERED APPROPRIATELY AND DURING THE MUSTERING, THREE CONTRACTOR INJURIES OCCURRED. TWO RECEIVED MINOR PUMPS AND BRUISE WHEREAS A THIRD FELL AND SUSTAINED A SHOULDER INJURY. POSSIBLE DISLOCATED SHOULDER, CONFIRMATION PENDING. ALL INVOLVED WITH THE WORK WERE SENT HOME. NO NATURAL GAS WAS RELEASED. AN UNKNOWN SMOKE WAS RELEASED FROM THE FIRE. ORIGINAL: THE CALLER IS REPORTING THAT CONTRACTORS WERE WELDING A NEW TIE IN ON A 36 IN HEADER ON A NATURAL GAS LINE TO INSTALL A NEW VALVE, WHEN THEY STUCK A SPARK DURING THE LAST FOOT OF WELDING WHICH CAUSED A 20 FOOT HIGH FLASH FIRE. THE CALLER STATES THAT 3 CONTRACTORS WERE INJURED AND ONE WENT TO THE HOSPITAL. THE CALLER STATES THAT THE FIRE WAS EXTINGUISHED IMMEDIATELY.
